source: https://tellent.recruitee.com/ (inline <svg> of the 'Hiring with Recruitee' badge, a[aria-label='Hiring with Recruitee'] in the footer of every Recruitee-hosted careers site; page saved as downloads/recruitee/src1/tellent.recruitee.com.html)
found_at: https://tellent.recruitee.com/ (Tellent's own careers site, served by Recruitee)
edits: kept only the two-people glyph (elements 20-23: pink #E23393 head, purple #5A1CB7 head and bodies); dropped 'Hiring with' (0-9), the 'tellent recruitee' wordmark (10-18, 24-30) and the lavender #ECE0F5 app-icon tile (19)
cropped the viewBox to the glyph (pad 0.02)
notes: DECISION: tile or bare glyph. Recruitee's app icon has a pale lavender tile (#ECE0F5) that vanishes on NoClick's light tile (icon_check lost_light 0.77), so I shipped the bare glyph, which reads on both themes; the tile version (elements 19-23, pad 0) is at work/agents/b25/alt/recruitee-tile.svg. The batch's homepage reference (ref0, a white 't' on purple) is the parent company Tellent's favicon, not Recruitee's. recruitee.com's header shows the Tellent logo; app.recruitee.com/assets/images/logo.svg is the retired 2015 Recruitee logo (Sketch 3.4, white).
